title: Lay the windows out as rows
show: (fun r -> String.concat " | " (List.map (fun a -> String.concat " " (List.map string_of_int a)) r))
hints: Run it and compare the rows. Which variable does the inner function never use?
Row `i` is the window that starts at `x.(i)`. Its element `j` sits `j` steps after that.
explain: Window `i` starts at `x.(i)`, so its element `j` is `x.(i + j)`. There are `Array.length x - k + 1` windows. Neighboring rows share `k - 1` numbers, which is the copying that implicit GEMM avoids.
